import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
    G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
gi,go=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
diffs=[(i,j,gi[i][j],go[i][j]) for i in range(30) for j in range(30) if gi[i][j]!=go[i][j]]
print('d1 diffs:',len(diffs), set(diffs[i][0] for diffs_ in [diffs] for i in diffs_) )
rowsc=sorted({i for _,i,_,_ in diffs})
cols_set=set(j for _,_,_,_ in diffs)
print('changed rows',rowsc,'columns',sorted(cols_set)[:10],'...' if len(cols_set)>10 else '')
print([ (go[i][j],gi[i][j]) for i,j,_,_ in diffs][:5])

def mrects(g):
    R=[]; seen=set()
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            c=g[i][j]; h=w=1
            while i+h<H and g[i+h][j]==c: h+=1
            while j+w<W and g[i][j+w]==c: w+=1
            if (h,w)==(1,1): continue
            if all(g[r][cc]==c for r in range(i,i+h) for cc in range(j,j+w)) and (i,j) not in seen:
                R.append((i,j,c,h,w)); seen.add((i,j))
    return R
